title: 配置百度网盘 Access Token
description: 请到百度网盘开放平台完成用户鉴权，获取 Access Token。凭证仅存储在本机，不会上传到云端。
description_en: Complete user authorization on the Baidu Netdisk open platform to get an Access Token. Credentials are stored locally only.
docLabel_en: How to get an Access Token?

fields.label: 百度网盘 Access Token
fields.placeholder: 粘贴网盘开放平台的 Access Token
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the Access Token from the Netdisk open platform
fields.description: 用于访问百度网盘远端 MCP 服务（SSE）。令牌会以 access_token 查询参数随请求发出，过期后需重新获取。
fields.description_en: Used to reach the Baidu Netdisk remote MCP server (SSE). The token travels as the access_token query parameter and must be renewed after it expires.
